content.text:
The site's custom font wasn't loading, so every page was falling back to the system font. I fixed it with a one-line change.

**The cause:** in `site/css/tokens.css:5`, the `@font-face` rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The server returned a 404, so "Acme Sans" never loaded and every page fell back to `system-ui`. That changed the letter shapes, widths and line breaks everywhere; the phone About page, for example, came out 27px taller.

**The fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

**Checked:**
- Before the fix, all 12 visual tests failed (6 pages × desktop and phone). After it, all 12 match the approved screenshots.
- All 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has only the initial commit, so git can't show which edit introduced the wrong path; the bad path is already in that commit. I left the change uncommitted.

STATUS: DONE
